title: The Supermarket
dek: One long supermarket wall, close up: fresh food, the fridge and freezer, the shelves and the checkout.
frames: There is some … / there are some …
Is there any …? Are there any …?

truefalse.s: The bananas are in the fridge.
There are eggs in the fridge.
The customer has got a trolley.
The cashier is standing at the entrance.
There is a basket of baguettes in the bakery.
The ice cream is in the freezer.
The shop assistant is holding a box.
The tomatoes are next to the lettuce.
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
The scales are next to the fruit and vegetables.
The special offer is on the grocery shelves.
The tins are on the top shelf.
There is a receipt coming out of the till.
The conveyor belt is behind the cashier.
The croissants are between the cakes and the bread.
The baskets are stacked by the automatic doors.

A1: Write a shopping list for a birthday party.
What fruit and vegetables do you like? What don't you like?
Look at the fridge. Write five sentences: There is… There are…
A2: You are at the checkout. Write the dialogue with the cashier.
Describe your family's weekly shopping: where, when and what you buy.
Plan a healthy dinner for four people. What do you need to buy?
B1: Is it better to shop in a supermarket, at a market or online? Give your reasons.
Supermarkets throw away a lot of food. What could they do about it?
Write a complaint: something you bought was out of date.

rooms.ex: We go to the supermarket every Saturday.
rooms.def: A big shop that sells food and things for the home.

rooms.ex: The bread in the bakery is still warm.
rooms.def: The part of a shop where bread and cakes are sold.

rooms.ex: There's a long queue at the checkout.
rooms.def: The place where you pay for your shopping.

parts.ex: The automatic doors opened as we walked in.
parts.def: Doors that open by themselves when you walk up to them.

parts.ex: Take a basket - we only need a few things.
parts.def: Containers with handles for carrying your shopping.

parts.ex: A kilo of apples, please.
parts.def: Round fruit with red, yellow or green skin.

parts.ex: These oranges are really juicy.
parts.def: Round sweet fruit with a thick orange skin.

parts.ex: Can you get two lemons for the fish?
parts.def: Sour yellow fruit.

parts.ex: We need tomatoes for the salad.
parts.def: Soft red fruit that we eat as a vegetable.

parts.ex: Wash the lettuce before you make the salad.
parts.def: A green vegetable with big leaves, eaten raw.

parts.ex: Rabbits love carrots.
parts.def: Long orange vegetables.

parts.ex: Bananas are on special offer this week.
parts.def: Long curved yellow fruit.

parts.ex: Buy a bag of potatoes for the chips.
parts.def: Round vegetables that grow under the ground.

parts.ex: Do you prefer green or red grapes?
parts.def: Small round green or purple fruit that grow in bunches.

parts.ex: The price tag says £1.20 a kilo.
parts.def: A small label that shows how much something costs.

parts.ex: Weigh the tomatoes on the scales.
parts.def: A machine for weighing things.

parts.ex: The cakes look delicious.
parts.def: Sweet food baked from flour, eggs and sugar.

parts.ex: Let's have croissants for breakfast.
parts.def: Soft curved pieces of pastry, eaten for breakfast.

parts.ex: A loaf of brown bread, please.
parts.def: A food made from flour, water and yeast, baked in an oven.

parts.ex: The baguettes are fresh this morning.
parts.def: Long thin loaves of French bread.

parts.ex: The milk is in the big fridge at the back.
parts.def: A cold cupboard that keeps food fresh.

parts.ex: Get two bottles of milk, please.
parts.def: A white drink that comes from cows.

parts.ex: I'd like some cheese for my sandwich.
parts.def: A food made from milk, often yellow.

parts.ex: We need butter to make the cake.
parts.def: A soft yellow food made from cream, for bread and cooking.

parts.ex: I have a strawberry yoghurt for breakfast.
parts.def: A thick food made from milk, often with fruit.

parts.ex: Half a dozen eggs, please.
parts.def: Oval things laid by hens, that we cook and eat.

parts.ex: The ice cream is in the freezer.
parts.def: A very cold cupboard that keeps food frozen.

parts.ex: Chocolate ice cream is my favourite.
parts.def: A sweet frozen food made from milk.

parts.ex: Frozen food lasts for months.
parts.def: Food that is kept very cold, like frozen peas or pizza.

parts.ex: Which cereal do you want?
parts.def: Food made from grain, eaten with milk for breakfast.

parts.ex: We're having pasta for dinner.
parts.def: An Italian food made from flour and water, like spaghetti.

parts.ex: Do you want rice or chips?
parts.def: Small white or brown grains that you cook in water.

parts.ex: Get two tins of tomatoes.
parts.def: Metal containers for food, like beans or soup.

parts.ex: A bottle of water, please.
parts.def: Glass or plastic containers for drinks.

parts.ex: Buy one, get one free - it's a special offer!
parts.def: A lower price for a short time.

parts.ex: Follow the signs to the checkout.
parts.def: A board that tells you where things are.

parts.ex: Ask the shop assistant where the rice is.
parts.def: A person who works in a shop.

parts.ex: She's putting tins on the shelf from a box.
parts.def: A container with flat sides, often made of cardboard.

parts.ex: The supermarket is full of customers on Saturdays.
parts.def: A person who buys things in a shop.

parts.ex: Our trolley is full!
parts.def: A big metal basket on wheels for your shopping.

parts.ex: The cashier asked if I had a bag.
parts.def: The person at the checkout who takes the money.

parts.ex: Put your shopping on the conveyor belt.
parts.def: A moving belt where you put your shopping at the checkout.

parts.ex: The cashier opened the till.
parts.def: The machine at the checkout that adds up the prices and keeps the money.

parts.ex: You can pay by card - tap it on the card machine.
parts.def: A small machine you pay with your bank card on.

parts.ex: Keep the receipt in case you need to bring it back.
parts.def: A piece of paper that shows what you bought and what you paid.

parts.ex: Don't forget your shopping bags!
parts.def: A bag for carrying your shopping home.
